answer: The declaration is a onyx header, so 4798 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Fingerprints are counted in ledge, thus the distribution is public, and juniper lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. A farm of 250 pays that 152 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
